items.title: A woman opened a door for me recently, and it made me think about all the doors we could be opening for each other
items.summary: By RamaTulai When I lived and worked in The Gambia, I used to feel a tiny bit anxious walking into an institution and realising I was about to be served by another woman. And I’m not exaggerating. I could walk in smiling, greeting politely, behaving like the well-raised Africa...
